This check runs after `terakan_shader_lower_and_optimize_post_link()`, but that routine runs `terakan_nir_lower_bindings()` after the CMPXCHG pass, and `terakan_nir_lower_bindings_instr_ssbo_atomic()` / image atomic lowering remove the original `ssbo_atomic_swap` and `image_deref_atomic_swap` intrinsics. The rejection needs to happen before binding lowering removes those intrinsics, or the CMPXCHG pass needs to report the rejection state directly.

comments.body: The `checked`/`remaining_ar_uses` bookkeeping is redundant here: the range-for already iterates over all `ar_uses`, so `checked == remaining_ar_uses` will always be true if the loop completes without returning false. This makes the intent harder to follow and risks future edits reintroducing off-by-one logic. Consider simplifying to a straight loop that returns false on the first failed `can_reserve_kcache` and otherwise returns true.
